scope: Final read-only wrapper/auditor/skill forward review; parser/auditor selfchecks only; no emulator

forward_review.request: Tenho bug VRAM/timing ROM.sms: qual emulador usar, roteiro com P1/P2+neutral e como avaliar?
forward_review.chosen_route: Emulicious privado para reproduzir a falha e medir vídeo/probe/throughput/worst-frame; BlastEm SMS privado como segunda observação de RAM/VDP/Z80 para uma hipótese concreta.
context_before_execution: Ler memory bank/GDD/spec/TDD reais e legíveis
Fixar SHA ROM, modelo/região e contrato de baseline
EIO/EACCES bloqueiam caso de produção; não inventar contexto
Substituir magic/endereço de fixture pelos predicados reais do jogo
forward_review.template_limits: Somente exemplo não executado; duração e warmup precisam casar com contrato real. Ausência de predicates implica generic_diagnostic_only, não aplicabilidade do caso. P1right8/P2button1=16; neutral explícito libera ambos.
review: Inspecionar logs e hashes, baseline/tamanhos, RAM/VRAM/VDP por fronteira e CPU coerente
Consumo P1/P2 precisa de telemetria/hook/probe da própria ROM; ACK/comando aplicado não bastam
Comparar estados homologados entre emuladores; não exigir igualdade de PC, boot-frame ou representações CRAM internas
Screenshot é um frame depois do último dump com inputs soltos; não é imagem daquele snapshot
Divergência abre hipótese e reteste; concordância não prova hardware físico
Não extrair FPS/duração CPU dos ciclos internos; PAL/audio/throughput BlastEm não qualificados

self_checks.scope: Synthetic schema fixtures, not ROM/runtime evidence

resolved_prior_findings.detail: Predicate count and explicit generic vs passed applicability present; auditor independently checks coverage/status.
check_dumps(root,0) runs before any binding input; truncated baseline selfcheck added.
cleanup_owned attempts both processes independently and closes FDs after first subprocess error; state failed on cleanup errors; selfcheck exercises first cleanup failure.
Precondition list/type/string/limit and unknown top-level fields rejected explicitly.

findings.title: CPU snapshot indices not validated against boundaries
findings.detail: Auditor compares decoded rows to metadata and checks length only. Consistently duplicated/reordered CPU indices can pass while boundaries are0..N; the wrapper itself rejects these.
findings.recommendation: Demand indices exactly range(len(bounds)), with negative selfcheck for duplicate/swappedCPU indices and correspondingly updated metadata/file hashes.

findings.title: Renderer rejection differs from wrapper
findings.detail: Auditor rejects falling back to SDL2 renderer but not Initialization of GLEW failed, which wrapper rejects.
findings.recommendation: Use shared qualified-renderer rejection helper or mirror both tokens; negative synthetic test should include GLEW failure plus matching hashes.

missing_contracts_and_limits.detail: Bundle auditor validates record acquisition/identity; it does not compare requested gestures with actual ROM input consumption or prove fighter action. Skill/workflow correctly demand real consumption. Future automated approval needs per-case hash-bound input/state trace contract.
Config/debugger commands are hash-bound but auditor does not reconstruct their semantic correspondence to sequence. Treat PASS as record consistency, not independent input execution authentication.
Monochrome256x192 can retain completed RAM diagnostic status; no visual pass. Only final screenshot+1 frame collected, no full motion/flicker timeline proof.
No realtime throughput, CPU-exclusive duration, PAL or audio/music verification in BlastEm backend; route to Emulicious for these axes.

Imported source hash is guarded and adapter_source.py is preserved. Full supporting release inventory remains locally recorded, not a separately pinned immutable manifest; keep provenance ceiling explicit.
Metadata polls direct owned parents; no claim of OS isolation/security or entire host liveness should be inferred.

recommendation: Correct F01/F02 and rerun focused selfchecks before accepting auditor consistency contract; central route/skill/workflow scope is appropriate. Native acceptance remains separate.
next_action: Coordinator fixes two audit gaps and seals final hashes; then own-session native workers evaluate real SMS traces and current-ROM eligibility. No product promotion.
